title: Commissioner Orren Vale
subtitle: Adversary · Main adversary · architect of the forged collection

fields.label: High concept / trouble
fields.value: The Man Who Keeps Tomorrow Solvent; I Can Explain Every Cruelty.

fields.label: Other aspects
fields.value: My Signature Opens Every Civic Door; The Hospital Knows What I Saved; No One Sees Me Hesitate.

fields.label: Goal / method
fields.value: Activate the altered collection roll before it can be audited. He uses injunctions, intermediaries and competing emergencies rather than immediate violence.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Contacts +4; Resources +3, Will +3; Deceive +2, Provoke +2, Rapport +2; Notice +1, Empathy +1, Fight +1, Physique +1. Unlisted +0.

fields.label: Durability
fields.value: Physical [1][2][3]; mental [1][2][3][4], one box per hit. Empty shared mild 2, moderate 4 and severe 6 consequences. No private NPC fate-point pool assigned.

fields.label: Stunt proposals
fields.value: Signed in Triplicate: +2 Deceive to create an advantage disguising a falsified civic audit trail among genuine documents. Official Channels: +2 Contacts to overcome when recruiting municipal assistance using a currently valid signed order.

fields.label: GM motive / counterplay
fields.value: He originally borrowed time to keep the hospital alive, then hid the shortfall with unsigned debtors. Reveal both facts, obtain a lawful counterseal, or separate the reserve from the collection machinery. He may concede by resigning and providing the override rather than accepting public disgrace of the hospital.
